title: Centered Flora
description: Removes Minecraft's random plant offsets for perfectly centered vegetation.
body:
## Centered Flora

Centered Flora is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that removes Minecraft's random model offsets from vegetation, keeping plants consistently centered.

## Features

- 🌼 Centers flowers
- 🌿 Centers grass and ferns
- 🌱 Centers saplings
- 🌾 Centers crops
- 🍄 Centers mushrooms
- 🌾 Centers other vegetation that uses Minecraft's random offset system

## Notes

Leaf Litter, Pink Petals and Wildflowers are intentionally unaffected. Unlike most vegetation, they use fixed model positions instead of Minecraft's random offset system.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21 - 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
